provenance.note: Authored from the MCP specification and Claude Code's documented behaviour, NOT captured from Claude Code — it was not available to record from when this corpus was built. The one case whose launch is fixed by this repository rather than by a vendor: the plugin's entry point execs `--writes host` (ADR-0057 decision 6). Its frames still want capturing, but `--writes host` is ours and is pinned here. Replace `send` with captured frames (see capture.sh) and set kind to `captured`; ADR-0057 decision 11 asks for the real ones.

result.instructions: Synveda is governed organisational memory. `recall` composes a context block from the scopes this identity's policy permits — reach for it when the answer might already be known here rather than reasoning from scratch. Results say whether they were reviewed and how fresh they are; weigh them on that.

tools.name: recall
tools.title: Recall governed memory
tools.description: Search governed organisational memory. Ask a question with `query` to compose a context block from every scope your policy lets you read. Results carry their channel (published means reviewed, derived means unreviewed), provenance, and validity window, so you can weigh them. What you may read is decided at call time under your own identity: material you have no access to is simply absent from the answer.

budget_tokens.description: Narrow the block's token budget. You may narrow and never widen: the policy pack's budget is the ceiling.
